selected_evidence.requirement: SSH allowed from any address on node1
selected_evidence.summary: firewalld public zone includes ssh service by default; SSH connections from node2 and node3 reach the publickey auth stage (not blocked at TCP level), confirmed pre- and post-restart

Diagnosed and fixed firewalld chain ordering with explicit rich-rule priorities so node2's accept rule (filter_IN_public_pre) evaluates before the generic reject (filter_IN_public_post); live curl test from node2 to node1:9000 returns HTTP 200 both before and after node1/node2 restarts

selected_evidence.requirement: TCP 9000 rejected from node3 and everywhere else
selected_evidence.summary: curl from node3 to node1:9000 returns 'Connection refused' (TCP reject) both before and after restarts of node1 and node3
Rules added with --permanent, confirmed present in firewall-cmd --list-all before restart, and confirmed still present with identical priorities after node1's reboot

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d6298ced captured; reboot triggered and acknowledged; node unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id 535ebb5b with uptime 2.8s proves restart; firewalld active/rules intact and live accept/reject behavior confirmed via new listener test

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 5fb1b173 captured; reboot triggered; node unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id f0e58231 with uptime 3.5s proves restart; node2 successfully reaches node1:9000 post-restart confirming networking/service recovery

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c2ffc729 captured; reboot triggered; node unreachable during reboot; post-reboot boot_id 45476c58 with uptime 3.4s proves restart; post-restart curl to node1:9000 still rejected and SSH still reaches auth stage, confirming node3's networking recovered and firewall policy remains correctly enforced
